authorization: Current user explicitly requested execution, hypothesis checks, five figures and analysis. Scope: cached H1 structural/frequency analysis only; H2 learning is planning only.
mean_match_method: D-only fixed-size within-mean-interval symmetric membership-swap MCMC; initialized at original D group; random member/nonmember proposals; reject outside target D mean +/- tolerance; no V selection
mean_match_missing_rule: Preserve every D non-singleton group. Undefined observed or any null T_b under common coverage rule makes primary H1b calibration insufficient. No selective null filtering or resampling.
display_group_rule: D size descending, stable IDs and deterministic per-group hash quotas

null.p_values: Approximate conditional calibration only; no guaranteed FWER with MCMC draws. If mixing/coverage fails, no primary p-values.
null.stop_rule: Stop null inference on qualification failure or budget. Preserve diagnostics; continue bounded descriptive figures and factual records.
null.comparison_rule: last two checkpoints and between-chain final summaries: abs difference <= max(absolute floor,0.1*max(abs(a),abs(b),0.02)); endpoints floor0.02, overlap/phi floor0.01. Necessary diagnostics, not a mixing proof.

practical_effect_thresholds: UNKNOWN: report effect size/uncertainty, no researcher-confirmed scientific PASS or practical-equivalence claim.
independence: exposed D/V within same bin; original documents/near duplicates UNKNOWN
mean_match_burnin_rule: Exactly10*size proposals including rejections; acceptance>=size is qualification only, not a random stopping time. Fixed proposal intervals preserve self-loops.
mean_match_jaccard_rule: Qualification of whole matched chain after fixed burn-in, not individual draw rejection. Retain all scheduled draws including repeats. If chain insufficient, entire group match insufficient.

sampling_correction.basis: Pre-endpoint reasoning audit: sampling after fixed accepted swaps creates an acceptance-biased jump chain. Formal retention must use fixed proposals including rejected self-loops. Qualification accepted-count checkpoints remain diagnostic only.
